definition.title: Compare equality and difference
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: 更 increases the degree relative to an understood comparison. 比 marks the comparison explicitly. For how an action is done, 得 can introduce the description containing 比. 更/还 may reinforce a 比 comparison. 跟…一样 can stand alone when the property is recoverable. 不比 denies being more; it does not assert being less. With differing actions, put 多/少/早/晚 before the verb and the difference after it. A describing phrase followed by 的 can stand for the understood one.
